title: Stability and Sensitivity Analysis of Relative Temporal-Difference Learning: Extended Version
summary: Relative temporal-difference (TD) learning was introduced to mitigate the slow convergence of TD methods when the discount factor approaches one by subtracting a baseline from the temporal-difference update. While this idea has been studied in the tabular setting, stability guarantees with function approximation remain poorly understood. This paper analyzes relative TD learning with linear function approximation.
